subject: Management plane degradation affecting GreenLeaf Health — updates and next steps
messages:
From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@greenleafhealth.com>
To: alex_martinez@redwood.example.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.example.com
Date: 2026-12-09T08:13:45-05:00
Subject: Management API 503s — immediate impact

Alex / Redwood team,

We started seeing 503 errors against the management endpoint for our private deployment in eu-west-1 at ~07:55 UTC. This is preventing us from starting new model rollouts and failing health-checks for a subset of agents. Data plane (inference) appears fine for existing sessions, but automation for canary rollouts is blocked.

Sample error from our side: 
[2026-12-09T07:56:02Z] POST /v1/management/rollouts 503 Service Unavailable {
  "error": "leader-election timeout",
  "node": "agent-12"
}

We have an active maintenance window later today but this is impacting our internal QA and a scheduled customer demo. Can you confirm you see this, what caused it, and what you are doing to mitigate? Attaching a short error snippet.

Thanks,
Priya Desai
Director of Cloud Operations | GreenLeaf Health
Attachment: error-snippet.txt

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.example.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya.desai@greenleafhealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.example.com, ben_carter@redwood.example.com
Date: 2026-12-09T08:25:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Management API 503s — immediate impact

Hi Priya — thanks for the heads up and the sample. We see the alerts coming from your eu-west-1 private deployment and our on-call has started triage. Short answers up front: we see elevated 503s on the management/agent control API, the data plane is not returning 5xx for inference traffic, and we have an immediate mitigation plan in progress.

Mitigation (in flight):
- Temporarily routing new management requests to your secondary control endpoint to restore rollout API availability (estimating <10 min to take effect).
- Rolling back the 4.3.1 management agent on the subset of nodes that are showing leader election timeouts.
- Collecting full diagnostics from the cluster for postmortem.

I'll keep you posted as we confirm full mitigation. Monica (CS) is on the thread to coordinate any downstream impacts and communication.

— Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: +1 415 555 0133

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
To: alex_martinez@redwood.example.com, monica_patel@redwood.example.com
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@greenleafhealth.com>
Date: 2026-12-09T09:10:30-05:00
Subject: Re: Management API 503s — immediate impact

Alex / Priya — brief technical summary from triage: we identified a regression introduced in management-agent v4.3.1 that affects leader election under certain NAT timeout conditions common in some VPC egress setups. Symptoms: control-plane RPCs intermittently fail with leader-election timeouts which surface as 503s from the management API. Data-plane inference traffic (model serving) remains pinned to existing leaders and was not impacted for in-flight sessions.

Actions taken (completed):
- Rolled back management-agent from v4.3.1 -> v4.3.0 on 6 of 8 affected controller nodes in GreenLeaf’s eu-west-1 deployment (nodes with highest error rates).
- Enabled short-circuit circuit-breaker on the management API for lessthan-critical routes to reduce cascading retries.
- Applied temporary backoff config to agent heartbeat and leader-election timeouts to reduce sensitivity to NAT spikes.

Impact window: ~07:55 UTC — 08:18 UTC for majority of affected requests (we continued to see low-volume 503s until rollback completed).

Attachments: diagnostic_bundle_greenleaf_20261209.tar.gz, config-diff-4.3.1-4.3.0.txt (contains the minimal diff showing the problematic election backoff value).

Next steps:
- Produce a full postmortem and RCA doc (owned by eng) with timeline and mitigation permanently folded into v4.3.2.
- Coordinate a controlled upgrade to v4.3.2 for your environment during a mutually agreed maintenance window (the fix adds conservative leader-election backoff and an additional health check).
- Provide the required evidence for SOC2/compliance (logs, signed change records).

Ben Carter
Sr. Staff Engineer, Runtime — Redwood Inference
Attachment: JIRA-RID-3421

From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@greenleafhealth.com>
To: alex_martinez@redwood.example.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.example.com, ben_carter@redwood.example.com, procurement@greenleafhealth.com
Date: 2026-12-09T11:02:12-05:00
Subject: Re: Management API 503s — immediate impact

Thanks for the rapid response and the interim mitigation. A few questions so we can close the loop internally:

1) Can you confirm whether any configuration or data was changed on the data plane (model artifacts, schemas)? We need a clear statement for our compliance team.
2) When do you expect the postmortem / RCA to be available? We have an audit next week and will need the timeline plus evidence of corrective actions.

We appreciate the quick rollback and the temporary fix. Please include in the postmortem whether this is something we should schedule proactively (i.e., will we need a maintenance window to upgrade to v4.3.2) and whether there are any customer-side network settings you recommend tuning to avoid similar issues.

Regards,
Priya
Director of Cloud Operations | GreenLeaf Health

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.example.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya.desai@greenleafhealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.example.com, ben_carter@redwood.example.com, security@redwood.example.com
Date: 2026-12-10T08:45:00-05:00
Subject: Follow-up: Postmortem, evidence, and next steps (GreenLeaf)

Hi Priya — quick update following Ben’s notes and our internal postmortem draft: 

1) Data plane impact: confirmed none. No model artifacts, customer data, or schema changes occurred as part of the incident. We will include a signed statement in the postmortem package.
2) Postmortem availability: draft postmortem and evidence bundle are available here: https://redwood-drive.example.com/greenleaf/postmortem-20261209 (read-only link). The postmortem includes timeline, RCA (regression in v4.3.1 leader-election backoff), root cause, corrective actions, and planned release notes for v4.3.2.
3) Planned remediation and schedule: we propose a controlled upgrade to v4.3.2 (contains the leader-election backoff fix and additional watchdog check) during your next maintenance window. Monica will coordinate available windows; we recommend the minor upgrade take ~30 minutes with a rolling approach to avoid disruption.

Attachments included in the evidence bundle: diagnostic_bundle_greenleaf_20261209.tar.gz, config-diff-4.3.1-4.3.0.txt, signed-change-record-rollback-20261209.pdf.

If you need an expedited on-call bridge to walk the audit team through the evidence, let us know and we’ll set that up.

Thanks again for your patience — we’ll follow up to schedule the upgrade and share the final postmortem once edits from the audit team are included.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwood.example.com
Phone: +1 415 555 0133
